name: Setup Wizard ESC wiring detection starts from half duplex on a YGE
step: Check Setup Wizard ESC wiring detection for a programmable ESC
rationale:
Issue #2739: the wiring search stops at the first wiring that delivers frames. An OpenYGE sends telemetry by itself, so half duplex off passes at once, and on that wiring its parameters cannot be read. The Setup Wizard then reports no link, with nothing saying why.

The page now writes half duplex to the flight controller before the walk starts, for an ESC whose parameters the wizard can read (lib/esc_params.lua), and the walk starts once that write is answered. Every ending puts the page's own wiring back after the flight controller's cancel. Telemetry only, found from that start, is said as such.

The harness drives the real page and the real trial message builder through the sequence: the write comes first and the walk waits for its answer; telemetry only and Found are told apart; a failed run and a Stop write the page's own wiring back; an ESC without a parameter family, or with half duplex on already, starts as configured; a refused write still starts the walk; a Stop before the write is answered starts nothing; the preset has no pin swap on F4 boards.

--self-test removes the preset and requires the write-first check to go red.
